short_description: Central sector income support scheme providing Rs. 6,000 annually to all landholding farmer families across India.
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
target_beneficiaries: Small and marginal landholding farmer families
benefits: Direct income support of Rs. 6,000 per year transferred directly into verified bank accounts.
Disbursed in three equal four-monthly installments of Rs. 2,000 each (April-July, August-November, December-March).
Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) via Aadhaar-seeded NPCI bank account.
eligibility_conditions: Applicant must be an Indian citizen.
The farmer family (husband, wife, and minor children) must own cultivable agricultural land as per official state land revenue records.
Landholding records must be updated in the state land database.
Bank account must be Aadhaar-linked and active with biometric/eKYC completed.
exclusion_conditions: Institutional landholders are strictly ineligible.
Farmer families where any member holds or held constitutional posts (e.g. President, Vice President, Governors, Ministers, MPs, MLAs, Mayors).
Serving or retired officers and employees of Central/State Government Ministries, Departments, or PSUs (excluding Multi-Tasking Staff / Group D / Class IV).
All superannuated / retired pensioners whose monthly pension is Rs. 10,000 or more (excluding Group D / MTS).
All persons who paid income tax in the last assessment year.
Professionals like Doctors, Engineers, Lawyers, Chartered Accountants, and Architects registered with professional bodies and carrying out practice.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card with mobile number linked for eKYC
Land ownership documents / RoR (Record of Rights) / Pattadar Passbook / Khatauni
Aadhaar-seeded bank passbook / account statement
Self-declaration certificate on non-exclusion criteria

scheme_name: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
short_description: World's largest public health assurance scheme providing Rs. 5 lakh annual hospitalization cover per family for secondary and tertiary care.
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (National Health Authority)
target_beneficiaries: Bottom 40% vulnerable rural and urban households and all citizens aged 70+
benefits: Cashless and paperless access to health services up to Rs. 5,00,000 per family per year.
Covers pre-existing conditions from day one.
Covers up to 3 days of pre-hospitalization and 15 days of post-hospitalization diagnostic and medicine expenses.
Expanded Ayushman Vay Vandana card providing top-up Rs. 5 lakh cover to all senior citizens aged 70 and above regardless of income.
eligibility_conditions: Rural households satisfying SECC 2011 deprivation criteria (D1: only 1 room with kucha walls/roof, D2: no adult member 16-59, D3: female headed without adult male, D4: disabled member with no able-bodied adult, D5: SC/ST, D7: landless manual casual labor).
Urban households belonging to 11 occupational categories (ragpickers, domestic workers, street vendors, transport drivers, construction workers, sanitation workers, etc.).
OR any individual aged 70 years and above (under the Senior Citizen Ayushman Vay Vandana sub-scheme).
exclusion_conditions: Households owning motorized 2/3/4 wheelers or fishing boats with motors.
Households owning mechanized agricultural equipment (tractors/harvesters).
Households with any family member who is a regular government employee.
Households with non-agricultural enterprises registered with the government.
Households paying professional tax or income tax.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card / Government Photo ID
Ration Card / PM-JAY Family ID / SECC confirmation
Age proof (for senior citizen 70+ category)

short_description: Flagship rural housing scheme providing financial assistance for construction of permanent pucca houses with basic amenities.
target_beneficiaries: Houseless rural families and those living in dilapidated/kutcha houses
benefits: Financial grant of Rs. 1,20,000 per unit in plain areas.
Financial grant of Rs. 1,30,000 per unit in hilly states, difficult areas, and Integrated Action Plan (IAP) tribal districts.
90 to 95 days of unskilled manual labor wage under MGNREGS (approx. Rs. 20,000+).
Additional Rs. 12,000 for household sanitary latrine construction under Swachh Bharat Mission (Gramin).
LPG connection support under PM Ujjwala Yojana and electricity connection under Saubhagya.
eligibility_conditions: Must be a rural resident family.
The family must be houseless or living in kutcha houses (zero, one, or two rooms with kutcha walls and kutcha roof) as prioritized by SECC 2011 and Awaas+ list.
Neither the applicant nor any family member must own a pucca permanent house anywhere in India.
exclusion_conditions: Ownership of motorized two, three, or four-wheelers, or mechanized boats.
Ownership of mechanized agricultural equipment or tractor.
Having a Kisan Credit Card (KCC) with credit limit of Rs. 50,000 or above.
Households where at least one member is a government employee.
Households with non-agricultural enterprise registered with government.
Households with any member paying income tax or professional tax.
Households with landline phone or owning 2.5 acres or more of irrigated land.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card of all adult household members
MGNREGA Job Card Number
Bank Account Passbook (Aadhaar linked)
Swachh Bharat Mission registration number
Land ownership or land possession certificate / consent from local Gram Panchayat

scheme_name: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students (NSP-CSSS)
short_description: Merit-cum-means scholarship providing financial support to meritorious students from low-income families pursuing regular higher education.
ministry: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education
benefits: Undergraduate: Rs. 12,000 per annum for the first three years of college.
Postgraduate: Rs. 20,000 per annum for 4th and 5th years (master's degree or integrated programs).
Technical courses (B.Tech/MBBS): Rs. 20,000 per annum in the 4th and 5th year.
Disbursed directly via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) into student's bank account.
eligibility_conditions: Student must have scored above the 80th percentile in the relevant stream in Class 12 (10+2 pattern) examination from a recognized State/Central Board.
Must be pursuing regular full-time undergraduate or postgraduate courses in a college or institution recognized by AICTE, UGC, or MCI.
Gross annual parental / family income must not exceed Rs. 4,50,000 per annum.
Applicant must not be availing of any other state or central scholarship or fee concession.
exclusion_conditions: Students pursuing diploma courses, vocational courses, or distance/correspondence education.
Parental annual income exceeding Rs. 4.5 lakh.
Students receiving any other scholarship or stipend from Central or State Government.
Students scoring below 50% marks in semester renewal examinations or failing attendance norms.
required_documents: Class 12 Passing Certificate and Marksheet showing percentile score
Income Certificate issued by competent Revenue Authority (Tehsildar/SDM)
College Admission Bonafide Certificate / Fee Receipt with Institute AISHE code
Aadhaar Card
Bank Account details in student's name (Aadhaar seeded)

scheme_name: Rythu Bandhu / Rythu Bharosa (Agriculture Investment Support)
short_description: Telangana government's pioneer input assistance scheme providing Rs. 10,000 to Rs. 15,000 per acre per year for agriculture and horticulture crops.
ministry: Department of Agriculture, Government of Telangana
target_beneficiaries: Farmer pattadars cultivating agricultural land in Telangana
benefits: Direct financial grant of Rs. 5,000 per acre per season (Rs. 10,000 per acre per year, enhanced under Rythu Bharosa framework up to Rs. 15,000).
Granted for both Kharif (monsoon) and Rabi (winter) crop cycles.
No restriction on crop type or harvest output; funds cover seeds, fertilizer, labor, and crop maintenance.
Disbursed directly into farmers' bank accounts through electronic Treasury DBT.
eligibility_conditions: Applicant must be a permanent resident farmer of Telangana State.
Must be an agricultural land titleholder with an active digital Pattadar Passbook issued through the Dharani portal (e-Pattadar Passbook).
The land must be cultivable agricultural land registered in the revenue department database.
exclusion_conditions: Non-agricultural land, real estate layouts, and commercial industrial plots are strictly excluded.
Land not recorded or recognized in the CCLA / Dharani portal database.
Tenant farmers (who do not hold ownership Pattadar titles in their own name) are not covered under Rythu Bandhu directly.
Government-owned or forest lands without registered pattadar titles.
required_documents: Dharani digital Pattadar Passbook / Passbook Number
Aadhaar Card
Bank Account details linked with Aadhaar in Telangana
Survey number and land extent details registered with Agriculture Extension Officer (AEO)
